name: Mock Layer 2 Switch Driver
notes: Hardware-free L2 switch driver for integration tests. Acknowledges VLAN operations (create_vlan, add_to_vlan, remove_from_vlan, delete_vlan) deterministically and supports failure injection via HERD_mock_fail_actions / HERD_mock_raise_actions / HERD_mock_sleep_ms field_data. Not for production use.
